name: Creature size, space, reach, and movement
description: Retains the previously approved nine-category universal size system and shared spatial mechanics from the legacy Rules Core; does not reintroduce source-edition-specific combat engines.

size.rule: Size supplies a default combat footprint, not a mandatory body geometry or reach. Creatures can specify their effective occupied space.
size.modifierPolicy: Historical 3.x AC and grapple modifiers are preserved for compatibility; applying them as native modifiers requires the applicable approved combat rule, not merely presence in this catalog.

reach.naturalReach: Defined by the creature or an inherited definition, independently of size; no universal numeric reach inferred here.
reach.attackReach: An individual natural or manufactured attack may define its own reach.
reach.opportunityAttacks: Use the native shared opportunity-attack rules; reach is not a separate edition-specific action system.

movement.resolution: Use one movement budget/action framework; speeds are per mode and may be inherited or overridden.
movement.splitMovement: Movement can be split around permitted actions under the adopted native 5.x-style baseline.
movement.flight: Flight speed is distinct from hover and special maneuverability restrictions; additional restrictions belong to an ability when applicable.
movement.burrowing: Burrow speed does not universally permit passage through every solid material.
movement.swimming: Swim speed does not grant breathing underwater.
movement.climbing: Climb speed does not automatically include specialized surface permissions such as Spider Climb.
movement.specialPermissions: Movement through solid objects, unusual materials, occupied areas, and similar exceptions comes from explicit capabilities.

positioning.squeezing: Use one native narrow-space/occupied-footprint procedure; special restrictions are ability-specific.
positioning.occupiedSpaces: Use the approved common size/occupancy framework.
positioning.gridIndependence: Distance and occupied space are game measurements; do not require square-grid-only resolution.
positioning.fiveFootStep: Not restored as a separate universal movement action.
positioning.historicalFlightManeuverability: Not a universal second flight subsystem; represent meaningful limitations as applicable creature features.

compatibility.existingMonsters: Preserve current stat-block sizes, speeds, and attack reach during data migration unless explicitly reconciled.
compatibility.presentation: Stat-block layout and formatting remain deferred.
compatibility.runtime: No executable evaluator is present in the rewrite branch.
